label: Вести / Водить
description: A 10-sentence card contrasting вести (one trip, now) with водить (habitual/round-trip; водить машину = drive a car).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: One trip now. Веду is determinate, first-person of вести. It names a single leading act toward one destination, в школу, the classic determinate trigger.
Strategic focus: Driving ability. Водит is indeterminate, third-person of водить, in the idiom водить машину, 'to drive a car'. It states a general skill, not one trip, so the indeterminate fits.
Strategic focus: One trip now. Ведёт is determinate, third-person of вести. One directed act of leading the class toward a single goal selects the determinate member.

missions.phrase: Она каждое утро водит дочку в сад.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Daily round-trips. Водит is indeterminate, third-person of водить. Каждое утро marks a repeated there-and-back routine, the core indeterminate trigger.
Strategic focus: Minimal pair, now. Веду is determinate; сейчас pins the leading to this moment and one outing. Compare with водить, which would mean walking the dog regularly.

missions.phrase: Я обычно вожу собаку в парк.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Minimal pair, habit. Вожу is indeterminate, first-person of водить. Обычно marks a repeated round-trip habit, the mirror of the determinate веду in the previous scene.

missions.phrase: Вчера отец вёл меня за руку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: One past trip. Вёл is the determinate masculine past of вести. It describes one directed leading act on a specific occasion, вчера, so the determinate past is correct.

Strategic focus: Past driving habit. Водил is the indeterminate masculine past of водить, the drive idiom водить грузовик. The long-ago span describes a habitual occupation, which selects the indeterminate form.
Strategic focus: One trip now. Ведёшь is determinate, second-person of вести. The question куда plus сейчас asks about one destination of a leading act in progress, a determinate context.
Strategic focus: Fixed direction. Ведёт is determinate, third-person of вести. A road points along one constant line toward a single goal, к реке, so the determinate form names that one direction.
